label: def:categorical-q-reeb-flow
title: Categorical q-Reeb flow
html:
Definition. Categorical q-Reeb flow

Let \xi denote the Reeb derivation of A (categorical Reeb derivation) and let [\cdot,\cdot]_q denote the q-Lie bracket (categorical q-Lie bracket). The q-deformed Reeb derivation \xi_q on A is

  \xi_q(a) = q^{-1}\xi(a) + (1 - q^{-1})[\xi, X_a]_q,

where X_a represents the horizontal derivation associated to a, satisfying \pi_H(da) = \iota_{X_a} \varTheta_A. The q-Reeb flow defines the unique one-parameter family of automorphisms \phi_t^q \in \mathrm{Aut}(A) generated by \xi_q.

\begin{equation}\label{eq:q-reeb-flow-diagram}
\begin{tikzcd}[row sep=2.5em, column sep=3em]
  A \ar[r, "\phi_t^q"] \ar[d, "\xi_q"']
  & A \ar[d, "\xi_q"] \\
  A \ar[r, "\phi_t^q"']
  & A
\end{tikzcd}
\qquad (\phi_0^q = \mathrm{id})
\end{equation}
